KITE Foundation confirms hack, deploys new ERC-20 contract with 1:1 migration –
Link
KITE Foundation confirmed a hacking incident causing abnormal KITE transfers on Ethereum, paused the token contract and cross-chain bridges, and is deploying a new ERC-20 contract. Balances will be reconstructed from a pre-incident snapshot at block 25,692,498 (Aug 6, 2026), and attacker-linked addresses will be excluded from redistribution.
Matters because: Full contract migrations are operationally complex and carry phishing risk, while liquidity and exchange support may stay constrained until migration completes.

tweet.text:
More people should know about the Interfold.

It's basically what I've been yelling at people to build with the MACI ideas ( https://ethresear.ch/t/minimal-anti-collusion-infrastructure/5413 ) for almost a decade, and now it exists, in a generalized form.

The idea is: a privacy protocol optimized for things like voting (and other use cases eg. secret-ballot auctions). The mechanism generates a threshold encryption key, and people send in their votes onchain, using a ZKP to prove eligibility. An arbitrary computation on the votes gets run inside FHE, and then threshold-decrypted.

From what I can tell (the docs are good https://docs.theinterfold.com/CRISP/introduction ), it gets pretty optimal security guarantees:

* Voter anonymity can be made unconditional if eligibility is proven with ZK-SNARKs
* Censorship resistance is guaranteed by ethereum (votes can be posted directly onchain, and there's a proof that all posted votes are taking into account)
* The correctness of the outputted

More people should know about the Interfold.

It's basically what I've been yelling at people to build with the MACI ideas ( https://ethresear.ch/t/minimal-anti-collusion-infrastructure/5413 ) for almost a decade, and now it exists, in a generalized form.

The idea is: a privacy protocol optimized for things like voting (and other use cases eg. secret-ballot auctions). The mechanism generates a threshold encryption key, and people send in their votes onchain, using a ZKP to prove eligibility. An arbitrary computation on the votes gets run inside FHE, and then threshold-decrypted.

From what I can tell (the docs are good https://docs.theinterfold.com/CRISP/introduction ), it gets pretty optimal security guarantees:

* Voter anonymity can be made unconditional if eligibility is proven with ZK-SNARKs
* Censorship resistance is guaranteed by ethereum (votes can be posted directly onchain, and there's a proof that all posted votes are taking into account)
* The correctness of the outputted

When people talk about robotics, they usually talk about models, data, or hardware. Few people talk about the infrastructure that lets you iterate on all three quickly. Today we're publishing how we trained Dyna-2 on over 1,000,000 hours of egocentric video, repeatably. At this scale, most of what worked at ten thousand hours did not hold up:

• ingestion throughput was capped at 14,000 episode-hours per week — a million hours would have taken over a year
• building a training manifest took 48 hours before a run could even start
• reading a petabyte from cloud storage during training left GPUs exposed to latency and packet loss

Been seeing a wave of many projects quietly laying off their team across crypto lately

Quite a few are friends and wanted to offer some thoughts for anyone affected or trying to break in the space

1. Important things to recognise
• Crypto today is very different compared to 2-4 years ago. Gone are the days when you can try to larp as a APAC lead without institutional connections or a DeFi lead raking in $200k a year doing (basically) nothing
• AI + mature tooling = a team of 10 now can do what 30 did in 2021. Most jobs that are cut are mostly being automated or absorbed and are not coming back. Keep that in mind when planning for future careers
• The north star for every company is revenue. Most crypto companies are vapourware (dead L1/L2, another prediction market/perp dex wrapper or some larp AI project) and are unable to fundraise from VCs these days and without cashflow your days are numbered
